# Design Inspiration Library

An open reference for web, app, branding and print/social design. **Nothing here is a rule.** Browse it, borrow from it, mix disciplines.

> Generated by `npm run library` from `entries/*.json`. Do not edit by hand — edit the entry JSON/MD and regenerate.

**1688 entries**


**Design styles (across all disciplines):** Minimalist (205) · Glassmorphism (160) · Dark & Neon (171) · Gradient & Aurora (143) · Geometric & Bauhaus (138) · Playful & Illustrated (136) · Warm & Organic (128) · Photographic & Cinematic (125) · Corporate & Clean-Tech (160) · 3D & Surreal (108) · Editorial (94) · Retro & Pixel (68) · Neo-Brutalist (52)
